# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

# Skill: Parsing MATPOWER-format Network Data in Python

## Overview
MATPOWER-format JSON files store power system network data using arrays of arrays with positional column semantics. This skill covers how to parse and interpret that data.

## Data Structure

### Bus Data (columns 0-12)
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | BUS_I | Bus number (1-indexed) |
| 1 | BUS_TYPE | 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack/Reference |
| 2 | PD | Real power demand (MW) |
| 3 | QD | Reactive power demand (MVAr) |
| 4 | GS | Shunt conductance (MW demanded at V=1.0 pu) |
| 5 | BS | Shunt susceptance (MVAr injected at V=1.0 pu) |
| 6 | BUS_AREA | Area number |
| 7 | VM | Voltage magnitude (pu) |
| 8 | VA | Voltage angle (degrees) |
| 9 | BASE_KV | Base voltage (kV) |
| 10 | ZONE | Loss zone |
| 11 | VMAX | Maximum voltage (pu) |
| 12 | VMIN | Minimum voltage (pu) |

### Generator Data (columns 0-9)
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | GEN_BUS | Bus number |
| 1 | PG | Real power output (MW) |
| 2 | QG | Reactive power output (MVAr) |
| 3 | QMAX | Maximum reactive power (MVAr) |
| 4 | QMIN | Minimum reactive power (MVAr) |
| 5 | VG | Voltage setpoint (pu) |
| 6 | MBASE | Machine base (MVA) |
| 7 | GEN_STATUS | 1=in-service |
| 8 | PMAX | Maximum real power (MW) |
| 9 | PMIN | Minimum real power (MW) |

### Branch Data (columns 0-12)
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | F_BUS | From bus number |
| 1 | T_BUS | To bus number |
| 2 | BR_R | Series resistance (pu) |
| 3 | BR_X | Series reactance (pu) |
| 4 | BR_B | Total line charging susceptance (pu) |
| 5 | RATE_A | Long-term MVA rating |
| 6 | RATE_B | Short-term MVA rating |
| 7 | RATE_C | Emergency MVA rating |
| 8 | TAP | Transformer off-nominal turns ratio (0 or 1 = no transformer) |
| 9 | SHIFT | Transformer phase shift angle (degrees) |
| 10 | BR_STATUS | 1=in-service |
| 11 | ANGMIN | Min angle difference (degrees) |
| 12 | ANGMAX | Max angle difference (degrees) |

### Generator Cost Data
| Index | Field | Description |
|-------|-------|-------------|
| 0 | MODEL | 1=piecewise linear, 2=polynomial |
| 1 | STARTUP | Startup cost ($) |
| 2 | SHUTDOWN | Shutdown cost ($) |
| 3 | NCOST | Number of cost coefficients |
| 4+ | COST | Coefficients (highest order first for polynomial) |

For polynomial model with NCOST=3: `cost = COST[0]*Pg^2 + COST[1]*Pg + COST[2]`

## Python Parsing Example

```python
import json
import numpy as np

with open('network.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data['baseMVA']
bus = np.array(data['bus'])
gen = np.array(data['gen'])
branch = np.array(data['branch'])
gencost = np.array(data['gencost'])

# Filter active components
active_gen = gen[gen[:, 7] == 1]
active_branch = branch[branch[:, 10] == 1]

# Handle transformer tap: 0 means 1.0 (no transformation)
taps = active_branch[:, 8].copy()
taps[taps == 0] = 1.0
```

## Key Conventions
- All impedances are in per-unit on baseMVA
- Powers (PD, QD, PG, QG, etc.) are in MW/MVAr
- Bus shunt GS is conductance in MW at V=1.0; BS is susceptance in MVAr at V=1.0
- Transformer tap ratio of 0 means unity (not actually zero)
- Branch admittance: Y = 1/(R + jX), shunt charging: jB/2 on each side for lines

# Skill: AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Formulation

## Overview
AC-OPF finds the least-cost generator dispatch that satisfies all AC power flow equations, voltage limits, generator limits, and branch thermal limits.

## Rectangular vs Polar Formulation

### Polar Formulation (used here)
Variables: Vm_i (voltage magnitude), Va_i (voltage angle), Pg_k, Qg_k for each generator k.

The power flow equations use bus admittance matrix entries.

### Bus Admittance Matrix Construction

For each branch (i,j) with series admittance Y_s = 1/(r+jx), charging B_c = jb, tap ratio τ∠θ_shift:

The π-model parameters from the math model are:
- Y_ij = Y_s (series admittance)
- Y^c_ij = jB_c/2 (from-side charging) — for transformers this is on the tap side
- Y^c_ji = jB_c/2 (to-side charging)
- T_ij = τ∠θ_shift (complex tap ratio)

**Branch power flow equations (from the math model):**

```
S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |V_i|^2 / |T_ij|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * V_i * conj(V_j) / T_ij
S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |V_j|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * conj(V_i) * V_j / conj(T_ij)
```

In polar coordinates with V_i = Vm_i ∠ Va_i:
```
V_i * conj(V_j) = Vm_i * Vm_j ∠ (Va_i - Va_j)
```

### Y-bus Approach (Equivalent)

Build bus admittance matrix Y_bus where:
- Diagonal: Y_bus[i,i] += (Y_s + Y^c_ij) / |T|^2 + Y^shunt_i  (for all branches at bus i)
- Off-diagonal: Y_bus[i,j] -= Y_s / T_ij*  (where T* is conjugate of T)

Power balance at bus i:
```
P_i = Vm_i * sum_j( Vm_j * (G_ij * cos(Va_i - Va_j) + B_ij * sin(Va_i - Va_j)) )
Q_i = Vm_i * sum_j( Vm_j * (G_ij * sin(Va_i - Va_j) - B_ij * cos(Va_i - Va_j)) )
```
where G_ij + jB_ij = Y_bus[i,j]

## Objective Function
```
minimize sum_k ( c2_k * Pg_k^2 + c1_k * Pg_k + c0_k )
```

## Constraints
1. **Power Balance**: Net injection = sum of branch flows at each bus
2. **Generator Limits**: Pmin ≤ Pg ≤ Pmax, Qmin ≤ Qg ≤ Qmax
3. **Voltage Limits**: Vmin ≤ Vm ≤ Vmax
4. **Reference Bus**: Va_ref = 0
5. **Branch Flow Limits**: |S_ij| ≤ S_max (apparent power thermal limit)
6. **Angle Difference**: θmin ≤ Va_i - Va_j ≤ θmax

## Implementation Notes
- Use per-unit system throughout (divide MW/MVAr by baseMVA)
- Bus shunts: GS is in MW at 1.0 pu → in pu: gs = GS/baseMVA; BS similarly
- Generator costs typically use MW directly (not per-unit)
- Branch flow limits (RATE_A) are in MVA → convert to pu by dividing by baseMVA
- If RATE_A = 0, the branch is unconstrained (set a large limit or skip)

# Skill: Pyomo for Nonlinear Optimization (AC-OPF)

## Overview
Pyomo is a Python-based algebraic modeling language. For AC-OPF, we use Pyomo's `ConcreteModel` with nonlinear constraints and the IPOPT solver.

## Setup
```bash
pip install pyomo numpy
# IPOPT solver (via IDAES):
pip install idaes-pse
idaes get-extensions
export PATH="/root/.idaes/bin:$PATH"
```

## Key Pyomo Components for OPF

### Model Creation
```python
import pyomo.environ as pyo
import os
os.environ['PATH'] = '/root/.idaes/bin:' + os.environ['PATH']

model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
```

### Sets
```python
model.buses = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
model.gens = pyo.Set(initialize=gen_ids)
model.branches = pyo.Set(initialize=branch_tuples)  # (from, to, idx)
```

### Variables
```python
model.Vm = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.PositiveReals, bounds=vm_bounds, initialize=1.0)
model.Va = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.Reals, initialize=0.0)
model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=pg_bounds)
model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=qg_bounds)
```

### Objective
```python
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(c2[g]*m.Pg[g]**2 + c1[g]*m.Pg[g] + c0[g] for g in m.gens)
model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)
```

### Power Balance Constraints
```python
def p_balance_rule(m, i):
    pg = sum(m.Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
    pd = load_p[i]
    gs = shunt_g[i]
    # Power injection = generation - load - shunt
    # Must equal sum of branch flows
    p_inj = pg - pd - gs * m.Vm[i]**2
    # Calculate branch flows using Y-bus
    p_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
        m.Vm[j] * (G[i,j]*pyo.cos(m.Va[i]-m.Va[j]) + B[i,j]*pyo.sin(m.Va[i]-m.Va[j]))
        for j in connected_buses[i]
    )
    return p_inj == p_calc
model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=p_balance_rule)
```

### Solving
```python
solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt')
solver.options['max_iter'] = 10000
solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'  # if available
results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)
```

### Extracting Results
```python

    vm = pyo.value(model.Vm[i])
    va = pyo.value(model.Va[i]) * 180 / 3.14159  # Convert to degrees
```

## IPOPT Solver Options
- `max_iter`: Maximum iterations (default 3000)
- `tol`: Convergence tolerance (default 1e-8)
- `acceptable_tol`: Acceptable tolerance for "acceptable" termination
- `linear_solver`: 'mumps', 'ma27', 'ma57' (MUMPS is open-source)
- `mu_init`: Initial barrier parameter
- `warm_start_init_point`: 'yes' for warm starts

## Tips for Large-Scale OPF
- Initialize variables from a flat start (Vm=1.0, Va=0.0) or DC-OPF solution
- Use sparse Y-bus construction
- Consider using the Y-bus form for power balance (sum over Y-bus entries, not individual branch flows) for computational efficiency
- IPOPT with MUMPS linear solver handles systems up to ~10,000 buses efficiently

# Skill: Y-Bus (Bus Admittance Matrix) Construction

## Overview
The bus admittance matrix (Y-bus) is central to power flow and OPF computations. This skill covers building Y-bus from MATPOWER branch data, accounting for transformers and shunts.

## Branch π-Model

Each branch has:
- Series impedance: z = r + jx → Series admittance: y_s = 1/z
- Line charging: total susceptance b → half on each side: jb/2
- Transformer: tap ratio τ (magnitude), shift angle θ (degrees)
- Complex tap: T = τ * exp(j*θ*π/180)

### Standard π-Model with Transformer

For branch from bus i to bus j with tap on bus i side:

```
Y_bus[i,i] += (y_s + j*b/2) / τ²
Y_bus[j,j] += (y_s + j*b/2)
Y_bus[i,j] -= y_s / conj(T)    = -y_s / (τ * exp(-jθ))
Y_bus[j,i] -= y_s / T           = -y_s / (τ * exp(jθ))
```

Note: This follows the math model convention where:
- Y_ij = y_s (series admittance)
- Y^c_ij = j*b/2 (from-side charging)
- Y^c_ji = j*b/2 (to-side charging)
- T_ij = τ * exp(j*θ)

## Python Implementation

```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

def build_ybus(bus, branch, baseMVA):
    nb = len(bus)
    nl = len(branch)

    # Bus indices mapping: bus_id -> 0-based index
    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    bus_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

    # Branch data
    f_bus = branch[:, 0].astype(int)
    t_bus = branch[:, 1].astype(int)
    r = branch[:, 2]
    x = branch[:, 3]
    b = branch[:, 4]
    tap = branch[:, 8].copy()
    shift = branch[:, 9] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians

    # Handle tap=0 → tap=1
    tap[tap == 0] = 1.0

    # Series admittance
    y_s = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)

    # Line charging (half on each side)
    b_c = 1j * b / 2.0

    # Complex tap ratio
    T = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

    # Initialize Y-bus
    Ybus = np.zeros((nb, nb), dtype=complex)

    for k in range(nl):
        i = bus_idx[f_bus[k]]
        j = bus_idx[t_bus[k]]

        Ybus[i, i] += (y_s[k] + b_c[k]) / (tap[k]**2)
        Ybus[j, j] += (y_s[k] + b_c[k])
        Ybus[i, j] -= y_s[k] / np.conj(T[k])
        Ybus[j, i] -= y_s[k] / T[k]

    # Add bus shunt admittances (GS in MW, BS in MVAr at V=1.0)
    for idx, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
        gs = bus[idx, 4] / baseMVA  # Convert to pu
        bs = bus[idx, 5] / baseMVA
        Ybus[idx, idx] += gs + 1j * bs

    return Ybus, bus_idx
```

## Branch Flow Computation (for reporting)

Given solved Vm, Va values, compute branch flows:

```python
def compute_branch_flows(branch, Vm, Va, bus_idx):
    """Compute complex power flows on each branch."""
    flows = []
    for k in range(len(branch)):
        i = bus_idx[int(branch[k, 0])]
        j = bus_idx[int(branch[k, 1])]

        r, x, b = branch[k, 2], branch[k, 3], branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * np.pi / 180

        y_s = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        bc = 1j * b / 2
        T = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

        Vi = Vm[i] * np.exp(1j * Va[i])
        Vj = Vm[j] * np.exp(1j * Va[j])

        # From math model:
        # S_ij = conj(y_s + bc) * |Vi|^2/|T|^2 - conj(y_s) * Vi*conj(Vj)/T
        S_ij = np.conj(y_s + bc) * (Vm[i]**2) / (tap**2) - np.conj(y_s) * Vi * np.conj(Vj) / T
        S_ji = np.conj(y_s + bc) * (Vm[j]**2) - np.conj(y_s) * np.conj(Vi) * Vj / np.conj(T)

        flows.append((S_ij, S_ji))
    return flows
```

## Key Considerations
- Parallel branches between same buses: Y-bus entries are additive
- Off-nominal transformers create asymmetric Y-bus entries (Y[i,j] ≠ Y[j,i]) when shift ≠ 0
- Always check for zero-impedance branches (may need special handling)

# Skill: OPF Results Extraction and Reporting

## Overview
After solving AC-OPF, extract results from the Pyomo model and compute derived quantities for the report.

## Key Metrics

### Total Cost
```python
total_cost = pyo.value(model.obj)
```

### Generation Totals
```python
total_gen_MW = sum(pyo.value(model.Pg[g]) * baseMVA for g in model.gens)
```


### Losses


### Branch Loading

```python
# Compute apparent power flows
S_ij_MVA = abs(S_ij) * baseMVA
S_ji_MVA = abs(S_ji) * baseMVA
max_flow = max(S_ij_MVA, S_ji_MVA)
```

### Feasibility Check

```python
for i in buses:
    p_gen = sum(Pg for generators at i)
    p_load = pd[i]
    p_shunt = gs[i] * Vm[i]**2
```

## Report JSON Structure
The report should include:
- `summary`: Aggregate system metrics

# Skill: AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Formulation

## Overview
AC-OPF finds the least-cost generator dispatch that satisfies all AC power flow equations, voltage limits, generator limits, and branch thermal limits.

## Rectangular vs Polar Formulation

### Polar Formulation (used here)
Variables: Vm_i (voltage magnitude), Va_i (voltage angle), Pg_k, Qg_k for each generator k.

The power flow equations use bus admittance matrix entries.

### Bus Admittance Matrix Construction

For each branch (i,j) with series admittance Y_s = 1/(r+jx), charging B_c = jb, tap ratio τ∠θ_shift:

The π-model parameters from the math model are:
- Y_ij = Y_s (series admittance)
- Y^c_ij = jB_c/2 (from-side charging) — for transformers this is on the tap side
- Y^c_ji = jB_c/2 (to-side charging)
- T_ij = τ∠θ_shift (complex tap ratio)

**Branch power flow equations (from the math model):**

```
S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |V_i|^2 / |T_ij|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * V_i * conj(V_j) / T_ij
S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |V_j|^2  -  conj(Y_ij) * conj(V_i) * V_j / conj(T_ij)
```

In polar coordinates with V_i = Vm_i ∠ Va_i:
```
V_i * conj(V_j) = Vm_i * Vm_j ∠ (Va_i - Va_j)
```

### Y-bus Approach (Equivalent)

Build bus admittance matrix Y_bus where:
- Diagonal: Y_bus[i,i] += (Y_s + Y^c_ij) / |T|^2 + Y^shunt_i  (for all branches at bus i)
- Off-diagonal: Y_bus[i,j] -= Y_s / T_ij*  (where T* is conjugate of T)

Power balance at bus i:
```
P_i = Vm_i * sum_j( Vm_j * (G_ij * cos(Va_i - Va_j) + B_ij * sin(Va_i - Va_j)) )
Q_i = Vm_i * sum_j( Vm_j * (G_ij * sin(Va_i - Va_j) - B_ij * cos(Va_i - Va_j)) )
```
where G_ij + jB_ij = Y_bus[i,j]

## Objective Function
```
minimize sum_k ( c2_k * Pg_k^2 + c1_k * Pg_k + c0_k )
```

## Constraints
1. **Power Balance**: Net injection = sum of branch flows at each bus
2. **Generator Limits**: Pmin ≤ Pg ≤ Pmax, Qmin ≤ Qg ≤ Qmax
3. **Voltage Limits**: Vmin ≤ Vm ≤ Vmax
4. **Reference Bus**: Va_ref = 0
5. **Branch Flow Limits**: |S_ij| ≤ S_max (apparent power thermal limit)
6. **Angle Difference**: θmin ≤ Va_i - Va_j ≤ θmax

## Implementation Notes
- Use per-unit system throughout (divide MW/MVAr by baseMVA)
- Bus shunts: GS is in MW at 1.0 pu → in pu: gs = GS/baseMVA; BS similarly
- Generator costs typically use MW directly (not per-unit)
- Branch flow limits (RATE_A) are in MVA → convert to pu by dividing by baseMVA
- If RATE_A = 0, the branch is unconstrained (set a large limit or skip)

## Overview
Pyomo is a Python-based algebraic modeling language. For AC-OPF, we use Pyomo's `ConcreteModel` with nonlinear constraints and the IPOPT solver.

## Setup
```bash
pip install pyomo numpy
# IPOPT solver (via IDAES):
pip install idaes-pse
idaes get-extensions
export PATH="/root/.idaes/bin:$PATH"
```

## Key Pyomo Components for OPF

### Model Creation
```python
import pyomo.environ as pyo
import os
os.environ['PATH'] = '/root/.idaes/bin:' + os.environ['PATH']

model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
```

### Sets
```python
model.buses = pyo.Set(initialize=bus_ids)
model.gens = pyo.Set(initialize=gen_ids)
model.branches = pyo.Set(initialize=branch_tuples)  # (from, to, idx)
```

### Variables
```python
model.Vm = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.PositiveReals, bounds=vm_bounds, initialize=1.0)
model.Va = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.Reals, initialize=0.0)
model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=pg_bounds)
model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=qg_bounds)
```

### Objective
```python
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(c2[g]*m.Pg[g]**2 + c1[g]*m.Pg[g] + c0[g] for g in m.gens)
model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)
```

### Power Balance Constraints
```python
def p_balance_rule(m, i):
    pg = sum(m.Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
    pd = load_p[i]
    gs = shunt_g[i]
    # Power injection = generation - load - shunt
    # Must equal sum of branch flows
    p_inj = pg - pd - gs * m.Vm[i]**2
    # Calculate branch flows using Y-bus
    p_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
        m.Vm[j] * (G[i,j]*pyo.cos(m.Va[i]-m.Va[j]) + B[i,j]*pyo.sin(m.Va[i]-m.Va[j]))
        for j in connected_buses[i]
    )
    return p_inj == p_calc
model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=p_balance_rule)
```

### Solving
```python
solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt')
solver.options['max_iter'] = 10000
solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'  # if available
results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)
```

### Extracting Results
```python
for i in model.buses:
    vm = pyo.value(model.Vm[i])
    va = pyo.value(model.Va[i]) * 180 / 3.14159  # Convert to degrees
```

## IPOPT Solver Options
- `max_iter`: Maximum iterations (default 3000)
- `tol`: Convergence tolerance (default 1e-8)
- `acceptable_tol`: Acceptable tolerance for "acceptable" termination
- `linear_solver`: 'mumps', 'ma27', 'ma57' (MUMPS is open-source)
- `mu_init`: Initial barrier parameter
- `warm_start_init_point`: 'yes' for warm starts

## Tips for Large-Scale OPF
- Initialize variables from a flat start (Vm=1.0, Va=0.0) or DC-OPF solution
- Use sparse Y-bus construction
- Consider using the Y-bus form for power balance (sum over Y-bus entries, not individual branch flows) for computational efficiency
- IPOPT with MUMPS linear solver handles systems up to ~10,000 buses efficiently

# Skill: Y-Bus (Bus Admittance Matrix) Construction

## Overview
The bus admittance matrix (Y-bus) is central to power flow and OPF computations. This skill covers building Y-bus from MATPOWER branch data, accounting for transformers and shunts.

## Branch π-Model

Each branch has:
- Series impedance: z = r + jx → Series admittance: y_s = 1/z
- Line charging: total susceptance b → half on each side: jb/2
- Transformer: tap ratio τ (magnitude), shift angle θ (degrees)
- Complex tap: T = τ * exp(j*θ*π/180)

### Standard π-Model with Transformer

For branch from bus i to bus j with tap on bus i side:

```
Y_bus[i,i] += (y_s + j*b/2) / τ²
Y_bus[j,j] += (y_s + j*b/2)
Y_bus[i,j] -= y_s / conj(T)    = -y_s / (τ * exp(-jθ))
Y_bus[j,i] -= y_s / T           = -y_s / (τ * exp(jθ))
```

Note: This follows the math model convention where:
- Y_ij = y_s (series admittance)
- Y^c_ij = j*b/2 (from-side charging)
- Y^c_ji = j*b/2 (to-side charging)
- T_ij = τ * exp(j*θ)

## Python Implementation

```python
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix

def build_ybus(bus, branch, baseMVA):
    nb = len(bus)
    nl = len(branch)

    # Bus indices mapping: bus_id -> 0-based index
    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    bus_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

    # Branch data
    f_bus = branch[:, 0].astype(int)
    t_bus = branch[:, 1].astype(int)
    r = branch[:, 2]
    x = branch[:, 3]
    b = branch[:, 4]
    tap = branch[:, 8].copy()
    shift = branch[:, 9] * np.pi / 180  # Convert to radians

    # Handle tap=0 → tap=1
    tap[tap == 0] = 1.0

    # Series admittance
    y_s = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)

    # Line charging (half on each side)
    b_c = 1j * b / 2.0

    # Complex tap ratio
    T = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

    # Initialize Y-bus
    Ybus = np.zeros((nb, nb), dtype=complex)

    for k in range(nl):
        i = bus_idx[f_bus[k]]
        j = bus_idx[t_bus[k]]

        Ybus[i, i] += (y_s[k] + b_c[k]) / (tap[k]**2)
        Ybus[j, j] += (y_s[k] + b_c[k])
        Ybus[i, j] -= y_s[k] / np.conj(T[k])
        Ybus[j, i] -= y_s[k] / T[k]

    # Add bus shunt admittances (GS in MW, BS in MVAr at V=1.0)
    for idx, bid in enumerate(bus_ids):
        gs = bus[idx, 4] / baseMVA  # Convert to pu
        bs = bus[idx, 5] / baseMVA
        Ybus[idx, idx] += gs + 1j * bs

    return Ybus, bus_idx
```

## Branch Flow Computation (for reporting)

Given solved Vm, Va values, compute branch flows:

```python
def compute_branch_flows(branch, Vm, Va, bus_idx):
    """Compute complex power flows on each branch."""
    flows = []
    for k in range(len(branch)):
        i = bus_idx[int(branch[k, 0])]
        j = bus_idx[int(branch[k, 1])]

        r, x, b = branch[k, 2], branch[k, 3], branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * np.pi / 180

        y_s = 1.0 / (r + 1j * x)
        bc = 1j * b / 2
        T = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

        Vi = Vm[i] * np.exp(1j * Va[i])
        Vj = Vm[j] * np.exp(1j * Va[j])

        # From math model:
        # S_ij = conj(y_s + bc) * |Vi|^2/|T|^2 - conj(y_s) * Vi*conj(Vj)/T
        S_ij = np.conj(y_s + bc) * (Vm[i]**2) / (tap**2) - np.conj(y_s) * Vi * np.conj(Vj) / T
        S_ji = np.conj(y_s + bc) * (Vm[j]**2) - np.conj(y_s) * np.conj(Vi) * Vj / np.conj(T)

        flows.append((S_ij, S_ji))
    return flows
```

## Key Considerations
- Parallel branches between same buses: Y-bus entries are additive
- Off-nominal transformers create asymmetric Y-bus entries (Y[i,j] ≠ Y[j,i]) when shift ≠ 0
- Always check for zero-impedance branches (may need special handling)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Uses Pyomo + IPOPT to solve the full AC-OPF problem from MATPOWER-format data.
Follows the mathematical model from math-model.md.
"""

import json
import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# Ensure IPOPT is on the PATH
os.environ['PATH'] = '/root/.idaes/bin:' + os.environ.get('PATH', '')


def load_network(filepath):
    """Load and parse MATPOWER-format JSON network data."""
    with open(filepath) as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']
    bus = np.array(data['bus'])
    gen = np.array(data['gen'])
    branch = np.array(data['branch'])
    gencost = np.array(data['gencost'])

    # Filter active components
    active_gen_mask = gen[:, 7] == 1
    active_branch_mask = branch[:, 10] == 1

    return {
        'baseMVA': baseMVA,
        'bus': bus,
        'gen': gen[active_gen_mask],
        'gen_idx': np.where(active_gen_mask)[0],  # original indices
        'branch': branch[active_branch_mask],
        'branch_idx': np.where(active_branch_mask)[0],
        'gencost': gencost[active_gen_mask],
    }


def build_ybus(net):
    """Build the bus admittance matrix."""
    bus = net['bus']
    branch = net['branch']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']
    nb = len(bus)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    bus_id_to_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

    Ybus = np.zeros((nb, nb), dtype=complex)

    for k in range(len(branch)):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]

        r = branch[k, 2]
        x = branch[k, 3]
        b = branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * math.pi / 180.0

        y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)
        b_c = complex(0, b / 2.0)
        T = tap * (math.cos(shift) + 1j * math.sin(shift))

        # From math-model: Y_ij = y_s, Y^c_ij = b_c, Y^c_ji = b_c, T_ij = T
        Ybus[i, i] += (y_s + b_c) / (tap ** 2)
        Ybus[j, j] += (y_s + b_c)
        Ybus[i, j] -= y_s / np.conj(T)
        Ybus[j, i] -= y_s / T

    # Add bus shunts (GS in MW at V=1 → pu, BS in MVAr at V=1 → pu)
    for idx in range(nb):
        gs = bus[idx, 4] / baseMVA
        bs = bus[idx, 5] / baseMVA
        Ybus[idx, idx] += complex(gs, bs)

    return Ybus, bus_id_to_idx


def build_opf_model(net, Ybus, bus_id_to_idx):
    """Build Pyomo AC-OPF model."""
    bus = net['bus']
    gen = net['gen']
    branch = net['branch']
    gencost = net['gencost']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']

    nb = len(bus)
    ng = len(gen)
    nl = len(branch)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    idx_to_bus_id = {i: bid for bid, i in bus_id_to_idx.items()}

    # Precompute G and B matrices
    G = Ybus.real
    B = Ybus.imag

    # Identify reference buses
    ref_buses_idx = [bus_id_to_idx[int(bus[i, 0])] for i in range(nb) if int(bus[i, 1]) == 3]

    # Map generators to buses (by index)
    gens_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[bus_id]
        gens_at_bus[bus_idx].append(g)

    # Load data per bus (in pu)
    Pd = bus[:, 2] / baseMVA
    Qd = bus[:, 3] / baseMVA

    # Precompute neighbor lists (buses connected via Y-bus nonzero entries)
    neighbors = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for i in range(nb):
        for j in range(nb):
            if G[i, j] != 0.0 or B[i, j] != 0.0:
                neighbors[i].append(j)

    # Build Pyomo model
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

    model.buses = pyo.Set(initialize=range(nb))
    model.gens = pyo.Set(initialize=range(ng))
    model.branches = pyo.Set(initialize=range(nl))

    # Variables: Voltage magnitude and angle
    def vm_bounds(m, i):
        return (float(bus[i, 12]), float(bus[i, 11]))  # (Vmin, Vmax)

    model.Vm = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.PositiveReals, bounds=vm_bounds, initialize=1.0)
    model.Va = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.Reals, initialize=0.0)

    # Variables: Generator power (in pu)
    def pg_bounds(m, g):
        return (float(gen[g, 9]) / baseMVA, float(gen[g, 8]) / baseMVA)

    def qg_bounds(m, g):
        return (float(gen[g, 4]) / baseMVA, float(gen[g, 3]) / baseMVA)

    model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=pg_bounds,
                       initialize=lambda m, g: float(gen[g, 1]) / baseMVA)
    model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=qg_bounds,
                       initialize=lambda m, g: float(gen[g, 2]) / baseMVA)

    # Objective: minimize generation cost
    # Cost function: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 (Pg in MW for cost evaluation)
    # gencost columns for model=2, ncost=3: [model, startup, shutdown, ncost, c2, c1, c0]
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            float(gencost[g, 4]) * (m.Pg[g] * baseMVA) ** 2 +
            float(gencost[g, 5]) * (m.Pg[g] * baseMVA) +
            float(gencost[g, 6])
            for g in m.gens
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Constraint: Reference bus angle = 0
    def ref_angle_rule(m, i):
        return m.Va[i] == 0.0
    model.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses_idx, rule=ref_angle_rule)

    # Constraint: Active power balance at each bus
    def p_balance_rule(m, i):
        # Generation at bus
        p_gen = sum(m.Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        # Net injection = generation - load
        p_inj = p_gen - Pd[i]
        # Power flow from Y-bus: P_i = Vm_i * sum_j(Vm_j * (G_ij*cos(θi-θj) + B_ij*sin(θi-θj)))
        p_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
            m.Vm[j] * (G[i, j] * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]) +
                       B[i, j] * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]))
            for j in neighbors[i]
        )
        return p_inj == p_calc
    model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=p_balance_rule)

    # Constraint: Reactive power balance at each bus
    def q_balance_rule(m, i):
        q_gen = sum(m.Qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        q_inj = q_gen - Qd[i]
        q_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
            m.Vm[j] * (G[i, j] * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]) -
                       B[i, j] * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]))
            for j in neighbors[i]
        )
        return q_inj == q_calc
    model.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=q_balance_rule)

    # Constraint: Branch apparent power flow limits
    # We formulate |S_ij|^2 <= (s^u)^2 for both directions
    def branch_flow_from_p(m, k):
        """Real part of S_ij (from-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        # Series admittance
        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        # From the math model S_ij formula, real part:
        # P_ij = (g_s + 0) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2
        #      - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(θi-θj-shift) + b_s*sin(θi-θj-shift))
        p_from = (g_s) * m.Vm[i]**2 / (tap**2) \
                 - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                     g_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift) +
                     b_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift))
        return p_from

    def branch_flow_from_q(m, k):
        """Imaginary part of S_ij (from-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        # Q_ij = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2
        #      - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(θi-θj-shift) - b_s*cos(θi-θj-shift))
        q_from = -(b_s + b_total/2) * m.Vm[i]**2 / (tap**2) \
                 - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                     g_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift) -
                     b_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift))
        return q_from

    def branch_flow_to_p(m, k):
        """Real part of S_ji (to-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        p_to = (g_s) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
               - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                   g_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift) +
                   b_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift))
        return p_to

    def branch_flow_to_q(m, k):
        """Imaginary part of S_ji (to-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        q_to = -(b_s + b_total/2) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
               - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                   g_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift) -
                   b_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift))
        return q_to

    # From-side thermal limit: P_ij^2 + Q_ij^2 <= (rate_a/baseMVA)^2
    def from_flow_limit_rule(m, k):
        rate_a = float(branch[k, 5])
        if rate_a <= 0:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        smax = rate_a / baseMVA
        pf = branch_flow_from_p(m, k)
        qf = branch_flow_from_q(m, k)
        return pf**2 + qf**2 <= smax**2
    model.from_flow_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=from_flow_limit_rule)

    # To-side thermal limit
    def to_flow_limit_rule(m, k):
        rate_a = float(branch[k, 5])
        if rate_a <= 0:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        smax = rate_a / baseMVA
        pt = branch_flow_to_p(m, k)
        qt = branch_flow_to_q(m, k)
        return pt**2 + qt**2 <= smax**2
    model.to_flow_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=to_flow_limit_rule)

    # Constraint: Voltage angle difference bounds
    def angle_diff_min_rule(m, k):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        angmin = float(branch[k, 11]) * math.pi / 180.0
        return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] >= angmin
    model.angle_diff_min = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=angle_diff_min_rule)

    def angle_diff_max_rule(m, k):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        angmax = float(branch[k, 12]) * math.pi / 180.0
        return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] <= angmax
    model.angle_diff_max = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=angle_diff_max_rule)

    return model


def solve_model(model):
    """Solve the OPF model using IPOPT."""
    solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt')
    solver.options['max_iter'] = 50000
    solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
    solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
    solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'
    solver.options['mu_strategy'] = 'adaptive'
    solver.options['print_level'] = 5

    results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)
    return results


def extract_results(model, net, Ybus, bus_id_to_idx):
    """Extract solution and build report."""
    bus = net['bus']
    gen = net['gen']
    branch = net['branch']
    gencost = net['gencost']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']

    nb = len(bus)
    ng = len(gen)
    nl = len(branch)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    idx_to_bus_id = {i: int(bid) for bid, i in bus_id_to_idx.items()}

    # Extract voltage solution
    Vm = np.array([pyo.value(model.Vm[i]) for i in range(nb)])
    Va = np.array([pyo.value(model.Va[i]) for i in range(nb)])  # radians

    # Extract generator dispatch
    Pg = np.array([pyo.value(model.Pg[g]) * baseMVA for g in range(ng)])  # MW
    Qg = np.array([pyo.value(model.Qg[g]) * baseMVA for g in range(ng)])  # MVAr

    # Total cost
    total_cost = pyo.value(model.obj)

    # Totals
    total_gen_MW = Pg.sum()
    total_gen_MVAr = Qg.sum()
    total_load_MW = bus[:, 2].sum()
    total_load_MVAr = bus[:, 3].sum()
    total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

    # Compute branch flows for reporting
    branch_results = []
    for k in range(nl):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]

        r = branch[k, 2]
        x = branch[k, 3]
        b_total = branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * math.pi / 180.0

        y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)
        g_s = y_s.real
        b_s = y_s.imag

        theta_ij = Va[i] - Va[j]

        # From-side power (pu)
        p_from = g_s * Vm[i]**2 / tap**2 \
                 - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.cos(theta_ij - shift) + b_s*math.sin(theta_ij - shift))
        q_from = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm[i]**2 / tap**2 \
                 - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.sin(theta_ij - shift) - b_s*math.cos(theta_ij - shift))

        # To-side power (pu)
        theta_ji = Va[j] - Va[i]
        p_to = g_s * Vm[j]**2 \
               - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.cos(theta_ji + shift) + b_s*math.sin(theta_ji + shift))
        q_to = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm[j]**2 \
               - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.sin(theta_ji + shift) - b_s*math.cos(theta_ji + shift))

        s_from = math.sqrt(p_from**2 + q_from**2) * baseMVA  # MVA
        s_to = math.sqrt(p_to**2 + q_to**2) * baseMVA  # MVA
        rate_a = branch[k, 5]

        loading = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100 if rate_a > 0 else 0

        branch_results.append({
            'from_bus': f,
            'to_bus': t,
            'loading_pct': round(loading, 2),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(s_from, 2),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(s_to, 2),
            'limit_MVA': round(rate_a, 2),
            'p_from_MW': round(p_from * baseMVA, 4),
            'q_from_MVAr': round(q_from * baseMVA, 4),
            'p_to_MW': round(p_to * baseMVA, 4),
            'q_to_MVAr': round(q_to * baseMVA, 4),
        })

    # Sort by loading
    branch_results.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

    # Feasibility check: compute mismatches
    G_mat = Ybus.real
    B_mat = Ybus.imag

    gens_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        bidx = bus_id_to_idx[bus_id]
        gens_at_bus[bidx].append(g)

    max_p_mismatch = 0.0
    max_q_mismatch = 0.0
    for i in range(nb):
        p_gen = sum(Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])  # MW
        q_gen = sum(Qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        p_load = bus[i, 2]
        q_load = bus[i, 3]

        p_calc = Vm[i] * sum(
            Vm[j] * (G_mat[i, j] * math.cos(Va[i] - Va[j]) + B_mat[i, j] * math.sin(Va[i] - Va[j]))
            for j in range(nb)
            if G_mat[i, j] != 0 or B_mat[i, j] != 0
        ) * baseMVA

        q_calc = Vm[i] * sum(
            Vm[j] * (G_mat[i, j] * math.sin(Va[i] - Va[j]) - B_mat[i, j] * math.cos(Va[i] - Va[j]))
            for j in range(nb)
            if G_mat[i, j] != 0 or B_mat[i, j] != 0
        ) * baseMVA

        p_mismatch = abs(p_gen - p_load - p_calc)
        q_mismatch = abs(q_gen - q_load - q_calc)
        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mismatch)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mismatch)

    # Voltage violations
    max_v_violation = 0.0
    for i in range(nb):

        vmax = bus[i, 11]
        v_viol = max(0, Vm[i] - vmax, vmin - Vm[i])
        max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, v_viol)

    # Branch overloads
    max_branch_overload = 0.0
    for br in branch_results:
        if br['limit_MVA'] > 0:
            overload = max(0, max(br['flow_from_MVA'], br['flow_to_MVA']) - br['limit_MVA'])
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Build report
    # Generators report
    gen_report = []
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        gen_report.append({
            'id': g + 1,
            'bus': bus_id,
            'pg_MW': round(Pg[g], 2),
            'qg_MVAr': round(Qg[g], 2),
            'pmin_MW': round(float(gen[g, 9]), 2),
            'pmax_MW': round(float(gen[g, 8]), 2),
            'qmin_MVAr': round(float(gen[g, 4]), 2),
            'qmax_MVAr': round(float(gen[g, 3]), 2),
        })

    # Buses report
    bus_report = []
    for i in range(nb):
        bus_report.append({
            'id': int(bus_ids[i]),
            'vm_pu': round(Vm[i], 6),
            'va_deg': round(Va[i] * 180.0 / math.pi, 4),
            'vmin_pu': round(float(bus[i, 12]), 2),
            'vmax_pu': round(float(bus[i, 11]), 2),
        })

    # Most loaded branches (top 5)
    most_loaded = []
    for br in branch_results[:5]:
        most_loaded.append({
            'from_bus': int(br['from_bus']),
            'to_bus': int(br['to_bus']),
            'loading_pct': br['loading_pct'],
            'flow_from_MVA': br['flow_from_MVA'],
            'flow_to_MVA': br['flow_to_MVA'],
            'limit_MVA': br['limit_MVA'],
        })

    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(total_cost, 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),
            'total_generation_MVAr': round(total_gen_MVAr, 2),
            'total_losses_MW': round(total_losses_MW, 2),
            'solver_status': 'optimal',

            'max_q_mismatch_MVAr': round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
            'max_voltage_violation_pu': round(max_v_violation, 6),
            'max_branch_overload_MVA': round(max_branch_overload, 4),
        },
    }

    return report


def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("AC Optimal Power Flow Solver")
    print("=" * 60)

    # Load network
    print("\nLoading network data...")
    net = load_network('/root/network.json')
    print(f"  Buses: {len(net['bus'])}")
    print(f"  Generators: {len(net['gen'])}")
    print(f"  Branches: {len(net['branch'])}")
    print(f"  BaseMVA: {net['baseMVA']}")

    # Build Y-bus

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Uses Pyomo + IPOPT to solve the full AC-OPF problem from MATPOWER-format data.
Follows the mathematical model from math-model.md.
"""

import json
import os
import math
import numpy as np
import pyomo.environ as pyo

# Ensure IPOPT is on the PATH
os.environ['PATH'] = '/root/.idaes/bin:' + os.environ.get('PATH', '')


def load_network(filepath):
    """Load and parse MATPOWER-format JSON network data."""
    with open(filepath) as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']
    bus = np.array(data['bus'])
    gen = np.array(data['gen'])
    branch = np.array(data['branch'])
    gencost = np.array(data['gencost'])

    # Filter active components
    active_gen_mask = gen[:, 7] == 1
    active_branch_mask = branch[:, 10] == 1

    return {
        'baseMVA': baseMVA,
        'bus': bus,
        'gen': gen[active_gen_mask],
        'gen_idx': np.where(active_gen_mask)[0],  # original indices
        'branch': branch[active_branch_mask],
        'branch_idx': np.where(active_branch_mask)[0],
        'gencost': gencost[active_gen_mask],
    }


def build_ybus(net):
    """Build the bus admittance matrix."""
    bus = net['bus']
    branch = net['branch']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']
    nb = len(bus)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    bus_id_to_idx = {bid: i for i, bid in enumerate(bus_ids)}

    Ybus = np.zeros((nb, nb), dtype=complex)

    for k in range(len(branch)):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]

        r = branch[k, 2]
        x = branch[k, 3]
        b = branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * math.pi / 180.0

        y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)
        b_c = complex(0, b / 2.0)
        T = tap * (math.cos(shift) + 1j * math.sin(shift))

        # From math-model: Y_ij = y_s, Y^c_ij = b_c, Y^c_ji = b_c, T_ij = T
        Ybus[i, i] += (y_s + b_c) / (tap ** 2)
        Ybus[j, j] += (y_s + b_c)
        Ybus[i, j] -= y_s / np.conj(T)
        Ybus[j, i] -= y_s / T

    # Add bus shunts (GS in MW at V=1 → pu, BS in MVAr at V=1 → pu)
    for idx in range(nb):
        gs = bus[idx, 4] / baseMVA
        bs = bus[idx, 5] / baseMVA
        Ybus[idx, idx] += complex(gs, bs)

    return Ybus, bus_id_to_idx


def build_opf_model(net, Ybus, bus_id_to_idx):
    """Build Pyomo AC-OPF model."""
    bus = net['bus']
    gen = net['gen']
    branch = net['branch']
    gencost = net['gencost']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']

    nb = len(bus)
    ng = len(gen)
    nl = len(branch)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    idx_to_bus_id = {i: bid for bid, i in bus_id_to_idx.items()}

    # Precompute G and B matrices
    G = Ybus.real
    B = Ybus.imag

    # Identify reference buses
    ref_buses_idx = [bus_id_to_idx[int(bus[i, 0])] for i in range(nb) if int(bus[i, 1]) == 3]

    # Map generators to buses (by index)
    gens_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        bus_idx = bus_id_to_idx[bus_id]
        gens_at_bus[bus_idx].append(g)

    # Load data per bus (in pu)
    Pd = bus[:, 2] / baseMVA
    Qd = bus[:, 3] / baseMVA

    # Precompute neighbor lists (buses connected via Y-bus nonzero entries)
    neighbors = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for i in range(nb):
        for j in range(nb):
            if G[i, j] != 0.0 or B[i, j] != 0.0:
                neighbors[i].append(j)

    # Build Pyomo model
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

    model.buses = pyo.Set(initialize=range(nb))
    model.gens = pyo.Set(initialize=range(ng))
    model.branches = pyo.Set(initialize=range(nl))

    # Variables: Voltage magnitude and angle
    def vm_bounds(m, i):
        return (float(bus[i, 12]), float(bus[i, 11]))  # (Vmin, Vmax)

    model.Vm = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.PositiveReals, bounds=vm_bounds, initialize=1.0)
    model.Va = pyo.Var(model.buses, within=pyo.Reals, initialize=0.0)

    # Variables: Generator power (in pu)
    def pg_bounds(m, g):
        return (float(gen[g, 9]) / baseMVA, float(gen[g, 8]) / baseMVA)

    def qg_bounds(m, g):
        return (float(gen[g, 4]) / baseMVA, float(gen[g, 3]) / baseMVA)

    model.Pg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=pg_bounds,
                       initialize=lambda m, g: float(gen[g, 1]) / baseMVA)
    model.Qg = pyo.Var(model.gens, bounds=qg_bounds,
                       initialize=lambda m, g: float(gen[g, 2]) / baseMVA)

    # Objective: minimize generation cost
    # Cost function: c2*Pg^2 + c1*Pg + c0 (Pg in MW for cost evaluation)
    # gencost columns for model=2, ncost=3: [model, startup, shutdown, ncost, c2, c1, c0]
    def obj_rule(m):
        return sum(
            float(gencost[g, 4]) * (m.Pg[g] * baseMVA) ** 2 +
            float(gencost[g, 5]) * (m.Pg[g] * baseMVA) +
            float(gencost[g, 6])
            for g in m.gens
        )
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Constraint: Reference bus angle = 0
    def ref_angle_rule(m, i):
        return m.Va[i] == 0.0
    model.ref_angle = pyo.Constraint(ref_buses_idx, rule=ref_angle_rule)

    # Constraint: Active power balance at each bus
    def p_balance_rule(m, i):
        # Generation at bus
        p_gen = sum(m.Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        # Net injection = generation - load
        p_inj = p_gen - Pd[i]
        # Power flow from Y-bus: P_i = Vm_i * sum_j(Vm_j * (G_ij*cos(θi-θj) + B_ij*sin(θi-θj)))
        p_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
            m.Vm[j] * (G[i, j] * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]) +
                       B[i, j] * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]))
            for j in neighbors[i]
        )
        return p_inj == p_calc
    model.p_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=p_balance_rule)

    # Constraint: Reactive power balance at each bus
    def q_balance_rule(m, i):
        q_gen = sum(m.Qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        q_inj = q_gen - Qd[i]
        q_calc = m.Vm[i] * sum(
            m.Vm[j] * (G[i, j] * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]) -
                       B[i, j] * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j]))
            for j in neighbors[i]
        )
        return q_inj == q_calc
    model.q_balance = pyo.Constraint(model.buses, rule=q_balance_rule)

    # Constraint: Branch apparent power flow limits
    # We formulate |S_ij|^2 <= (s^u)^2 for both directions
    def branch_flow_from_p(m, k):
        """Real part of S_ij (from-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        # Series admittance
        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        # From the math model S_ij formula, real part:
        # P_ij = (g_s + 0) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2
        #      - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(θi-θj-shift) + b_s*sin(θi-θj-shift))
        p_from = (g_s) * m.Vm[i]**2 / (tap**2) \
                 - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                     g_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift) +
                     b_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift))
        return p_from

    def branch_flow_from_q(m, k):
        """Imaginary part of S_ij (from-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        # Q_ij = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2
        #      - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(θi-θj-shift) - b_s*cos(θi-θj-shift))
        q_from = -(b_s + b_total/2) * m.Vm[i]**2 / (tap**2) \
                 - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                     g_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift) -
                     b_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift))
        return q_from

    def branch_flow_to_p(m, k):
        """Real part of S_ji (to-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        p_to = (g_s) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
               - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                   g_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift) +
                   b_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift))
        return p_to

    def branch_flow_to_q(m, k):
        """Imaginary part of S_ji (to-side flow)."""
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        r = float(branch[k, 2])
        x = float(branch[k, 3])
        b_total = float(branch[k, 4])
        tap = float(branch[k, 8]) if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = float(branch[k, 9]) * math.pi / 180.0

        denom = r*r + x*x
        g_s = r / denom
        b_s = -x / denom

        q_to = -(b_s + b_total/2) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
               - m.Vm[i] * m.Vm[j] / tap * (
                   g_s * pyo.sin(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift) -
                   b_s * pyo.cos(m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift))
        return q_to

    # From-side thermal limit: P_ij^2 + Q_ij^2 <= (rate_a/baseMVA)^2
    def from_flow_limit_rule(m, k):
        rate_a = float(branch[k, 5])
        if rate_a <= 0:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        smax = rate_a / baseMVA
        pf = branch_flow_from_p(m, k)
        qf = branch_flow_from_q(m, k)
        return pf**2 + qf**2 <= smax**2
    model.from_flow_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=from_flow_limit_rule)

    # To-side thermal limit
    def to_flow_limit_rule(m, k):
        rate_a = float(branch[k, 5])
        if rate_a <= 0:
            return pyo.Constraint.Skip
        smax = rate_a / baseMVA
        pt = branch_flow_to_p(m, k)
        qt = branch_flow_to_q(m, k)
        return pt**2 + qt**2 <= smax**2
    model.to_flow_limit = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=to_flow_limit_rule)

    # Constraint: Voltage angle difference bounds
    def angle_diff_min_rule(m, k):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        angmin = float(branch[k, 11]) * math.pi / 180.0
        return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] >= angmin
    model.angle_diff_min = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=angle_diff_min_rule)

    def angle_diff_max_rule(m, k):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]
        angmax = float(branch[k, 12]) * math.pi / 180.0
        return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] <= angmax
    model.angle_diff_max = pyo.Constraint(model.branches, rule=angle_diff_max_rule)

    return model


def solve_model(model):
    """Solve the OPF model using IPOPT."""
    solver = pyo.SolverFactory('ipopt')
    solver.options['max_iter'] = 50000
    solver.options['tol'] = 1e-6
    solver.options['acceptable_tol'] = 1e-4
    solver.options['linear_solver'] = 'mumps'
    solver.options['mu_strategy'] = 'adaptive'
    solver.options['print_level'] = 5

    results = solver.solve(model, tee=True)
    return results


def extract_results(model, net, Ybus, bus_id_to_idx):
    """Extract solution and build report."""
    bus = net['bus']
    gen = net['gen']
    branch = net['branch']
    gencost = net['gencost']
    baseMVA = net['baseMVA']

    nb = len(bus)
    ng = len(gen)
    nl = len(branch)

    bus_ids = bus[:, 0].astype(int)
    idx_to_bus_id = {i: int(bid) for bid, i in bus_id_to_idx.items()}

    # Extract voltage solution
    Vm = np.array([pyo.value(model.Vm[i]) for i in range(nb)])
    Va = np.array([pyo.value(model.Va[i]) for i in range(nb)])  # radians

    # Extract generator dispatch
    Pg = np.array([pyo.value(model.Pg[g]) * baseMVA for g in range(ng)])  # MW
    Qg = np.array([pyo.value(model.Qg[g]) * baseMVA for g in range(ng)])  # MVAr

    # Total cost
    total_cost = pyo.value(model.obj)

    # Totals
    total_gen_MW = Pg.sum()
    total_gen_MVAr = Qg.sum()
    total_load_MW = bus[:, 2].sum()
    total_load_MVAr = bus[:, 3].sum()
    total_losses_MW = total_gen_MW - total_load_MW

    # Compute branch flows for reporting
    branch_results = []
    for k in range(nl):
        f = int(branch[k, 0])
        t = int(branch[k, 1])
        i = bus_id_to_idx[f]
        j = bus_id_to_idx[t]

        r = branch[k, 2]
        x = branch[k, 3]
        b_total = branch[k, 4]
        tap = branch[k, 8] if branch[k, 8] != 0 else 1.0
        shift = branch[k, 9] * math.pi / 180.0

        y_s = 1.0 / complex(r, x)
        g_s = y_s.real
        b_s = y_s.imag

        theta_ij = Va[i] - Va[j]

        # From-side power (pu)
        p_from = g_s * Vm[i]**2 / tap**2 \
                 - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.cos(theta_ij - shift) + b_s*math.sin(theta_ij - shift))
        q_from = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm[i]**2 / tap**2 \
                 - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.sin(theta_ij - shift) - b_s*math.cos(theta_ij - shift))

        # To-side power (pu)
        theta_ji = Va[j] - Va[i]
        p_to = g_s * Vm[j]**2 \
               - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.cos(theta_ji + shift) + b_s*math.sin(theta_ji + shift))
        q_to = -(b_s + b_total/2) * Vm[j]**2 \
               - Vm[i]*Vm[j]/tap * (g_s*math.sin(theta_ji + shift) - b_s*math.cos(theta_ji + shift))

        s_from = math.sqrt(p_from**2 + q_from**2) * baseMVA  # MVA
        s_to = math.sqrt(p_to**2 + q_to**2) * baseMVA  # MVA
        rate_a = branch[k, 5]

        loading = max(s_from, s_to) / rate_a * 100 if rate_a > 0 else 0

        branch_results.append({
            'from_bus': f,
            'to_bus': t,
            'loading_pct': round(loading, 2),
            'flow_from_MVA': round(s_from, 2),
            'flow_to_MVA': round(s_to, 2),
            'limit_MVA': round(rate_a, 2),
            'p_from_MW': round(p_from * baseMVA, 4),
            'q_from_MVAr': round(q_from * baseMVA, 4),
            'p_to_MW': round(p_to * baseMVA, 4),
            'q_to_MVAr': round(q_to * baseMVA, 4),
        })

    # Sort by loading
    branch_results.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)

    # Feasibility check: compute mismatches
    G_mat = Ybus.real
    B_mat = Ybus.imag

    gens_at_bus = {i: [] for i in range(nb)}
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        bidx = bus_id_to_idx[bus_id]
        gens_at_bus[bidx].append(g)

    max_p_mismatch = 0.0
    max_q_mismatch = 0.0
    for i in range(nb):
        p_gen = sum(Pg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])  # MW
        q_gen = sum(Qg[g] for g in gens_at_bus[i])
        p_load = bus[i, 2]
        q_load = bus[i, 3]

        p_calc = Vm[i] * sum(
            Vm[j] * (G_mat[i, j] * math.cos(Va[i] - Va[j]) + B_mat[i, j] * math.sin(Va[i] - Va[j]))
            for j in range(nb)
            if G_mat[i, j] != 0 or B_mat[i, j] != 0
        ) * baseMVA

        q_calc = Vm[i] * sum(
            Vm[j] * (G_mat[i, j] * math.sin(Va[i] - Va[j]) - B_mat[i, j] * math.cos(Va[i] - Va[j]))
            for j in range(nb)
            if G_mat[i, j] != 0 or B_mat[i, j] != 0
        ) * baseMVA

        p_mismatch = abs(p_gen - p_load - p_calc)
        q_mismatch = abs(q_gen - q_load - q_calc)
        max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, p_mismatch)
        max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, q_mismatch)

    # Voltage violations
    max_v_violation = 0.0
    for i in range(nb):
        vmin = bus[i, 12]
        vmax = bus[i, 11]
        v_viol = max(0, Vm[i] - vmax, vmin - Vm[i])
        max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, v_viol)

    # Branch overloads
    max_branch_overload = 0.0
    for br in branch_results:
        if br['limit_MVA'] > 0:
            overload = max(0, max(br['flow_from_MVA'], br['flow_to_MVA']) - br['limit_MVA'])
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

    # Build report
    # Generators report
    gen_report = []
    for g in range(ng):
        bus_id = int(gen[g, 0])
        gen_report.append({
            'id': g + 1,
            'bus': bus_id,
            'pg_MW': round(Pg[g], 2),
            'qg_MVAr': round(Qg[g], 2),
            'pmin_MW': round(float(gen[g, 9]), 2),
            'pmax_MW': round(float(gen[g, 8]), 2),
            'qmin_MVAr': round(float(gen[g, 4]), 2),
            'qmax_MVAr': round(float(gen[g, 3]), 2),
        })

    # Buses report
    bus_report = []
    for i in range(nb):
        bus_report.append({
            'id': int(bus_ids[i]),
            'vm_pu': round(Vm[i], 6),
            'va_deg': round(Va[i] * 180.0 / math.pi, 4),
            'vmin_pu': round(float(bus[i, 12]), 2),
            'vmax_pu': round(float(bus[i, 11]), 2),
        })

    # Most loaded branches (top 5)
    most_loaded = []
    for br in branch_results[:5]:
        most_loaded.append({
            'from_bus': int(br['from_bus']),
            'to_bus': int(br['to_bus']),
            'loading_pct': br['loading_pct'],
            'flow_from_MVA': br['flow_from_MVA'],
            'flow_to_MVA': br['flow_to_MVA'],
            'limit_MVA': br['limit_MVA'],
        })

    report = {
        'summary': {
            'total_cost_per_hour': round(total_cost, 2),
            'total_load_MW': round(total_load_MW, 2),
            'total_load_MVAr': round(total_load_MVAr, 2),
            'total_generation_MW': round(total_gen_MW, 2),

    print("=" * 60)

    print(f"  Branches: {len(net['branch'])}")

    # Solve
